subject.title: fix(memory): respect QMD timeout for memory_search

question: Should memory.qmd.limits.timeoutMs intentionally extend interactive QMD-backed memory_search calls only during QMD command execution while the rest of the tool remains on default bounded deadlines?
rationale: The code path is technically sound and proven, but changing the runtime effect of an existing timeout setting affects user-visible wait behavior and needs maintainer acceptance before merge.

options.title: Accept Scoped QMD Semantics
options.body: Land the PR after merge refresh, treating the existing QMD command timeout as the owner-controlled budget for QMD command execution in memory_search.

options.title: Require Separate Opt-In
options.body: Ask for a revised patch if maintainers want a new explicit setting before raised QMD command timeouts can lengthen interactive agent waits.

options.title: Defer To Broader Timeout Work
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer one product direction for general memory_search timeout configuration across QMD and non-QMD backends.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped QMD Semantics
recommendation.body: Land the PR after merge refresh, treating the existing QMD command timeout as the owner-controlled budget for QMD command execution in memory_search.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current repair commit and has the strongest recent history on this timeout boundary.
